statement:
∀ (f g g' : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ),
  (∀ (x : ℝ), HasDerivAt g (g' x) x) →
    Continuous g' → Continuous f → ∫ (x : ℝ) in a..b, f (g x) * g' x = ∫ (u : ℝ) in g a..g b, f u

integrals.function: fun x => f (g x) * g' x

goal.text: ∫ (x : ℝ) in a..b, f (g x) * g' x = ∫ (u : ℝ) in g a..g b, f u
goal.rhs: ∫ (u : ℝ) in g a..g b, f u
goal.lhs: ∫ (x : ℝ) in a..b, f (g x) * g' x
goal.expr: (definite_integral((F_f(F_g(i0_)) * F_g_(i0_)), i0_, x2, x3)) - (definite_integral(F_f(i0_), i0_, F_g(x2), F_g(x3)))

atoms: ∫ (x : ℝ) in a..b, f (g x) * g' x
